analysis: Integration of four source passes. The PR is docs plus a small change to ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy.swift. Docs: changelog.d/qwen38-mtp-forced-tools.md (new) and docs/architecture/inference.md (date bump at line 3, new tool_choice paragraph near head lines 715-719). Code: the hardcoded qwen38ConstrainedModelID is replaced by ModelRuntimeRequirements.qwen38ConcreteModelIDs.contains(model.id), so the embedded-MTP Qwen3.8-27B build may now advertise forced tool_choice, still ANDed with Qwen35TemplateFix.applies. In validateParser (~head line 151) the qwen3_5 model-type prefix now counts as nativeQwen, so the framed format is .qwen35 instead of .nemotron. The guard still accepts only .xmlFunction or the family-framed format, and it runs only under the .structuredPostValidation strategy, so it does not newly admit models. No change to encryption, key handling, attestation, coordinator-provider auth, plaintext fail-closed behavior (T-008), or the prefix cache (T-041, SEC-035). Forced-tool constrained decoding sits in TB-007/TB-002 and affects output shape only. Unverified items, outside the supplied evidence: the contents of qwen38ConcreteModelIDs (should be a closed exact-ID set, not a prefix match), Qwen35TemplateFix.applies semantics, that invalidToolPayload still fails closed, and the coordinator routing consumer of toolConstraintModels. These are recorded as contracts not verified, not as findings. No supported security findings.
